notes: Bug fixes for YouTube search and the visualizer. The Music filter re-showed the Videos results, because results were cached per query but not per filter. Switching between Videos and Music did nothing at all with Live search turned off - picking a filter now re-runs the search either way. Live search off no longer means YouTube is queried on every keystroke anyway: the setting covered the result list but not the autocomplete dropdown. And the audio visualizer no longer goes flat when two sets of bars are on screen at once - opening the full player, or scrolling the playing row out of the list, used to switch the audio capture off underneath the bars still showing.
